[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Focus on proper form and breathing techniques.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Incorporate brick workouts (biking followed by running).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Listen to the body and take rest days as needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Hydrate and fuel properly with a balanced diet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Get enough sleep (7-9 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Mix up running routes to avoid boredom.
